reading.title: A Night at the Hotel
reading.text: Mr and Mrs Brown arrived at the Sunrise Hotel at six o'clock in the evening. They had a reservation for a double room with a view of the sea. The receptionist gave them a form to fill in. Then she gave them a key and told them to take the lift to the second floor. A young man carried their luggage. The room was big and clean. It had a shower, a TV and a hairdryer. The next morning they asked for a wake-up call at seven o'clock. After breakfast they checked out and paid the bill.

reading.title: Dinner at the Restaurant
reading.text: On Sunday evening, the Rakhimov family went to a restaurant. A waiter brought the menu. Father chose soup as a starter. Mother ordered a mixed salad because she is vegetarian. For the main course, Father had a steak with chips. He asked for it well-done. The children wanted fish and chips. They all drank soft drinks. For dessert, everybody had chocolate ice cream. The waiter asked, "Is everything all right?" Mother said, "Thank you, it is delicious." At the end, Father asked for the bill and paid. It was a lovely evening.

reading.title: Sport in My Family
reading.text: Everybody in my family loves sport. My father plays football with his friends every Saturday on the pitch near our house. My mother goes running every morning before work. My brother does karate at the sports centre on Tuesdays and Thursdays. My sister plays volleyball for her school team. I like swimming best. I go to the swimming pool every Sunday with my cousin. In winter we sometimes go skiing in the mountains. It is cold, but it is a lot of fun. What is your favourite sport?

reading.title: A Night at the Cinema
reading.text: On Friday evening, Aziz and his friends went to the cinema. There were five films on that week: a comedy, a cartoon, a horror film, an action film and a western. Aziz wanted to see the action film because his favourite actor is the film star in it. His friend Bobur chose the comedy. In the end, they all watched the action film. It was very exciting and fast. After the film, they bought popcorn and talked about the story. Bobur said the film was good, but he did not like the end. Aziz said it was the best film of the year. They go to the cinema about once a month.

reading.title: My Free Time
reading.text: At the weekend I like to relax at home. On Saturday morning I help my mother cook lunch. I really like cooking. In the afternoon I play video games or chat with my friends online. In the evening we watch a DVD or a programme on TV. On Sunday my cousin often comes to stay. We listen to music with our headphones and read comics. My grandfather likes gardening and he grows beautiful flowers and vegetables. After lunch he has a sleep on the sofa. Sometimes I just do nothing, and that is nice too.
